listings.name: 1960s Consul Trixi
listings.description: A rare variant of the popular Consul 232 Czechoslovakian-made portable — the only one I've come across in five years of research and trading. Sleek 60s look, equally at home on the working-from-home desk or the table of an arty coffee bar.

listings.name: 1970s Remington Envoy III
listings.description: An 'almost new' feel despite being over 50 years old. As with all my typewriters, deep cleaned and fettled. S/n 1X 38 32 87.
